title: Travel Phone Holder
shortDescription: A compact 3D-printed phone holder for comfortable, practical, hands-free travel.
concept: A compact, adjustable phone holder designed for travelers who need hands-free access to their devices. The design adapts to different environments, including luggage, tables, and airplane seats, while focusing on portability and stability.
designProcess: Research → Sketching → 3D Modeling → Joint Development → 3D Printing → Prototype Testing → Design Refinement

title: Nabeeh
shortDescription: A digital twin concept that detects camel crossings and alerts drivers to nearby hazards.
concept: NABEEH is a digital twin-based road safety concept designed to reduce camel-vehicle collisions on Saudi highways. The system uses real-time detection and a mobile application to warn drivers of nearby hazards through clear visual and audio alerts.
designProcess: Problem Identification → User Research → Benchmarking → UI/UX Design → Interactive Prototyping → Usability Testing
additionalDetails: Developed an interactive mobile prototype featuring live risk maps, audio and visual alerts, hazard reporting, bilingual support, and dark mode to improve accessibility and minimize driver distraction.

title: Light of the Stars
shortDescription: Follow the stars through an atmospheric 3D journey inspired by the desert landscape of AlUla.
concept: Light of the Stars is an exploration-based 3D game set in a nighttime desert inspired by AlUla. Players guide a lost traveler through the environment, collecting six stars to unlock the final path to safety. The experience combines environmental storytelling, lighting, and interactive gameplay.
designProcess: Story Development → Environment Modeling → Unity Integration → Gameplay Programming → Lighting & Audio → Testing

title: MushRoomy Restaurant
shortDescription: A fantasy-themed restaurant inspired by nature and mushroom shapes.
concept: MushRoomy is a fantasy-themed restaurant inspired by nature and mushroom shapes. The design combines soft pastel colors, organic forms, and playful details to create a cozy, magical dining environment.
designProcess: Concept Development → 3D Modeling → Materials & Texturing → Lighting → Rendering

title: Night Wolf
shortDescription: A wearable character head prototype inspired by a fantasy wolf character.
concept: Night Wolf is a wearable character head prototype inspired by a fantasy wolf character. The project explores how cardboard and simple crafting materials can be transformed into a detailed three-dimensional form through structural design and surface finishing.
designProcess: Ideation & Sketching → Internal Structure → Facial Features → Surface Development → Painting & Finishing
additionalDetails: Developed a lightweight cardboard structure reinforced with wire, then built the facial features using layered cardboard. Paper mâché was applied to refine the shape and create a smoother surface before painting.
